name: 德国欧盟蓝卡
summary: 面向持有高等教育或同等层级资格、并获得与资格匹配的德国工作邀请的人士。薪资门槛每年调整。
summaryEn: For people with a higher-education or comparable qualification and a German job offer matching it. Salary thresholds change annually.

qualification.summary: 通常须有德国学历、与德国学历相当的外国学历，或符合规定的至少三年制高等教育层级资格；部分 IT 人士另有经验路线。
qualification.summaryEn: Normally requires a German or comparable foreign degree, or a qualifying tertiary credential of at least three years; some IT professionals have an experience route.

jobOffer.summary: 须有至少六个月的德国具体工作邀请，工作与资格匹配；受监管职业还涉及执业许可。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A specific German job offer for at least six months is required and must match the qualification; regulated professions may require a licence.

salary.summary: 2026 年一般税前年薪至少 50,700 欧元；符合紧缺职业或毕业未满三年的情形可适用 45,934.20 欧元门槛及相应审批条件。
salary.summaryEn: For 2026, the general threshold is €50,700 gross annually; €45,934.20 and associated approval rules may apply to shortage occupations or recent graduates within three years.

sources.authority: German Federal Government — Make it in Germany
sources.title: EU Blue Card

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
